title: Educational and Informative Interventions to Tackle Inappropriate Use of Drugs in Italy
brief_summary: Pharmacological intervention is an essential step in health promotion. However, lots of drugs are often used in inappropriate ways, especially in elderly patients. This study is aiming at evaluating the effectiveness of educational and/or informative interventions addressed to general practitioners and their adult patients in Italy, in order to improve appropriateness of prescribing in primary care.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* general practitioners of the Italian National Health System (NHS) operating at December 31, 2016 belonging to the 8 Local Health Units involved in the project

Exclusion Criteria:

* primary care pediatricians
